message.content:
Here’s a classic list of ingredients you’ll need to bake a delicious chocolate cake (for a 9‑inch round cake, about 2 layers):

| Ingredient | Amount | Notes |
|------------|--------|-------|
| All‑purpose flour | 1 ¾ cups (220 g) | Sifted; use cake flour for an extra tender crumb. |
| Unsweetened cocoa powder | ¾ cup (75 g) | Dutch‑processed gives a richer flavor. |
| Granulated sugar | 2 cups (400 g) | White or brown; white gives a lighter color. |
| Baking powder | 1 ½ tsp | Leavening agent; make sure it’s fresh. |
| Baking soda | 1 ½ tsp | Works with acidic cocoa for rise. |
| Salt | 1 ½ tsp | Enhances flavor. |
| Eggs | 2 large | Room temperature for better emulsion. |
| Whole milk | 1 cup (240 ml) | Room temperature; can substitute with almond or oat milk. |
| Vegetable oil | ½ cup (120 ml) | Neutral‑flavored; can replace with melted butter for richer taste. |
| Vanilla extract | 2 tsp | Pure vanilla for depth. |
| Boiling water | 1 cup (240 ml) | Activates cocoa and creates a moist crumb. |
| Optional: 1–2 tbsp coffee |  | Intensifies chocolate flavor. |

**Optional extras for extra richness:**
- ¼ cup melted dark chocolate or chocolate chips (adds depth).
- ½ cup sour cream or Greek yogurt (makes the cake extra moist).
- 1 tsp instant espresso powder (boosts chocolate flavor).

**For frosting (optional):**
- ½ cup unsalted butter, softened
- 3 cups powdered sugar
- ¼ cup unsweetened cocoa powder
- ¼–½ cup milk or heavy cream
- 1 tsp vanilla extract

Feel free to adjust quantities based on your oven size or personal taste. Happy baking!
